sources.title: MOSS Voice-Acting — Emotion LoRAs vs Baseline - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Emotion LoRAs — does a specialist adapter help, and what does it cost? 17 adapters, each trained on the top 1 % of its own emotion (filtered so that measured naturalness and vocal-burst blend are both above the corpus median), rank 16, 5 epochs. Every adapter is compared against the same baseline — SFT-3 with the CFG-DPO adapter, the best general checkpoint measured so far — on identical ...

sources.title: laion/vocal-burst-lora-adapters · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 64 PEFT/LoRA adapters for laion/moss-tts-local-transformer-4.55b-voice-acting-v2, one per non-verbal vocal-burst class (laughs, sighs, gasps, whistles, breathing, grunts, moans, etc.), trained on classifier-filtered DramaBox audio and selected from a pool of 77 trained classes using a listening evaluation, not the automatic metric alone.

sources.title: LAION
sources.snippet: Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network TRULY OPEN AI. 100% NON-PROFIT. 100% FREE. LAION, as a non-profit organization, provides datasets, tools and models to liberate machine learning research. By doing so, we encourage open public education and a more environment-friendly use of resources by reusing existing datasets and models. Re-LAION 5B release (30.08.2024)
